tips.text: Run the Void solo; every extra squadmate adds 25 kills to each threshold and splits the Specters.
Stand still on high ground near a captive and let Specters come to you; running around spreads them out.
Bring Mesa or Revenant with Danse Macabre and stand on a rock; both clear 75 kills with little effort.
Bring the Xoris even on a nuke frame; only it frees captives for the extra time.
Equip Preparation; entering the Void resets your energy like a fresh map load.
Bring an On-Call crewmate or a Vapor Specter to clear the 75 kills while you collect the timer pyramids.
Farm the Systems tier last, or fold Zenith crowns into Sisters of Parvos or Steel Path play.
Leave the Solaris captives on the Corpus Ship alone until after your Void run; freeing them can disable your abilities inside.
Bring ammo and energy for the whole run; no ammo or energy orbs drop inside the Void.
Kill a Zanuka Hunter that entered the mission before you spend the crown; it can teleport you out of the Void.
Pick the node with the shortest tileset for the crown, such as Phobos Iliad assassination over Skyresh capture.
Kill the Corpus outside before opening the Void; folklore says it makes the Specter waves denser.
Expect two to four hours of runs for all three parts when the RNG behaves, and 40 or more for one part when it does not.
Players call it worth the time, since the Stropha, Stahlta and Velox parts in the same table are good weapons.
